outcome: maternal outcomes (gestational diabetes mellitus, preterm premature rupture of membranes, placenta accreta spectrum, postpartum hemorrhage)
cohort: The study participants were 3270 twin pregnancies (2003 spontaneously conceived and 1209 conceived by IVF/ICSI) identified from the National Birth Registry of China.
finding: In twin pregnancies, IVF/ICSI is independently associated with multiple maternal complications, including gestational diabetes mellitus, preterm premature rupture of membranes, and placenta accreta spectrum, but not an independent risk factor for neonate outcomes.
